about.title: William Norland
about.introduction: My greatest passion is to learn and to solve: understanding how things work, why they exist, and how to build solutions from first principles. My background spans software engineering, machine learning, and data science, with a focus on breaking down complex problems and designing reliable, scalable systems.
about.skillSummary: With a B.Sc. in Software Engineering and an M.Sc. in Data Science & AI from Chalmers University of Technology, supplemented by research in agentic AI at the University of Tokyo (LISD Lab), I possess a solid foundation in both production software architecture and the mathematical principles of machine learning. My experience spans machine learning engineering in industry—designing recommendation algorithms, generative models, and full-stack systems—as well as teaching object-oriented programming.

items.description:
Primarily working as a part-time Machine learning engineer in combination with my studies at CTH but have been in contact with many technical aspects of Weon such as:
- Size recommendation algorithms.
- 3D measurement systems.
- Data collection.
- Generative Image models.
- Frontend web design.
- Backend logic and Databases.
- API servers.

Teaching assistant in two courses (TDA553, TDA367) about Object Oriented Programming (OOP), one teaching the basics of OOP using Java, and one where students formed groups to produce a Java project over the span of half a semester.

Worked primarily with letters of credit and collections. I also developed a tool in Python to digitize a large backlog with paper documents, which also could extract key numbers from them and export them to Excel. The tool used Tesseract (an OCR software) and a simple GUI built with TKinter.

Worked as an anti-ship soldier in the “bekämpningskompaniet” unit and also as a sonar operator in an anti-submarine group, first as a conscript but also as an employed soldier for a year after the conscription ended. During my time at Amf4, I was also responsible for the platoon's physical training.
